a: bhānuḥ [bhā-nu Uṇ. 3. 32] 1 Light, lustre, brightness. 2 A ray of light; maṃḍitākhiladikprāṃtāścaṃḍāṃśoḥ pāṃtu bhānavaḥ Bv. 1. 129; Śi. 2. 53 Ms. 8. 132. 3 The sun; bhānuḥ sakṛdyuktaturaṃga eva Ś. 5. 4; bhīmabhānau nidāghe Bv. 1. 30. 4 Beauty. 5 A day. 6 A king, prince, sovereign. 7 An epithet of Śiva. — f. A handsome woman. Comp. — keśa (sa) raḥ the sun. — jaḥ the planet Saturn. — dinaṃ, — vāraḥ Sunday.
